name: graphql-live-task

states.name: Task Status Display
states.description: The live panel header shows task identity and current status. Status updates are pushed via WebSocket subscription, not polled.

states.name: Task Metadata
states.description: Below the header, a metadata grid shows key task run properties.
states.precondition: Task run was created from a workflow

states.name: Live Progress Indicator
states.description: A progress indicator shows the most recent event from the WebSocket subscription. Updates automatically as steps execute.

states.name: Lifecycle Controls
states.description: Inline buttons for managing the task. Controls are context-sensitive to current status. Backed by GraphQL mutations with automatic cache update.

states.name: Error Display
states.description: Error messages from failed tasks are displayed prominently.

states.name: Loading State
states.description: Initial data fetch shows a loading indicator.

states.name: Panel Visibility Rules
states.description: The live panel conditionally renders based on task status.

states.name: Real-Time Update Behavior
states.description: Status and progress updates arrive via WebSocket push within seconds, not via HTTP polling.

states.name: Visual Style
states.description: The panel follows the runner's dark theme design system.

description: GraphQL Live Task Panel — real-time task monitoring component embedded in the Run Summary page. Appears only when the selected task run is in 'running' status. Uses GraphQL WebSocket subscriptions for zero-polling updates. Includes inline lifecycle controls backed by GraphQL mutations.
